resources.string: Broadcast is on the server
Connecting to the server..
Relay through the server stopped. The broadcast on your network continues.

Every broadcast of this watch is announced on your exchange server from its start, and the relay through the server starts by itself. Audio is encrypted on the watch and cannot be heard by the server operator.
Reachable on this network only.
To use your account, open Exchange server on the phone and choose Connect watch.
This broadcast is unavailable. Open it again from the phone.
Help on the phone
Why won\'t it connect?
See the details on the phone.
A guest account cannot do this. If you need it, ask for an invitation of the kind \"own device or family\".
This server does not take a clipboard of this size, or has the clipboard turned off. Send something smaller, or ask whoever runs the server.
The server cannot take this: it has reached a limit of its own, or the item is too big to be listed.
The device or the server is not available right now.
This device was removed from the account.
The password of this account was changed, so this device was signed out.
The login or the password is wrong.
This program and the server speak different versions of the exchange.
Cannot reach the server.
The server did not answer.
A protected connection could not be set up.

The server refused this.
Too many attempts in a row.
A limit set on the server has been reached.
The server accepts this only over a protected connection, and this one is not protected.
The server already knows another device under this device\'s number. Remove this server from the list and add it again.
The server has no free port to open for this folder.

Cannot reach the device.

This folder is locked with a PIN. Enter the PIN to open it.
This device cannot receive protected content yet, so nothing is sent to it through the server.
The protection key of this device has changed, so nothing is sent to it. Remove the device from the account and add it again.

This could not be opened on this device. Try again from the other device.
This format is newer than this program supports. Nothing was imported. Use a compatible program.
